reviews.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

Approving. Every rate matches the pricing page: Opus 5.5 $4 / $20 / $0.20 cache read / $5 5-minute write, Sonnet 5.5 $2 / $10 / $0.10 / $2.50, and Haiku 5.5 $0.10 / $0.50 / $0.01 / $0.125 up to 100,000 prompt tokens and $0.50 / $2.50 / $0.05 / $0.625 above. The threshold is strictly greater than 100,000, and the prompt length includes cache reads and writes, as the page says. Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 have no long-context tier, so none is missing. `claude-opus-5` still hits the generic rule, and date suffixes, provider prefixes (`us.anthropic.…`) and `[1m]` match the new entries.

- [P2 non-blocking] `PRICE_TABLE_VERSION` stays `anthropic-2026-09-09` while the Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 prices change. Stored rows are never repriced, so rows priced before and after this change carry the same label with different rates. Bumping the version keeps them apart; a one-line follow-up is fine.
- [P3 nit] The 1-hour cache write ($8 Opus 5.5, $4 Sonnet 5.5, $0.20 / $1 Haiku 5.5) is priced at the 5-minute rate, the same as every other model, since transcripts carry no TTL. Not introduced here.

Real-CLI record (built CLI, a Stop hook through `teamai dashboard-report`, costs in micro-USD, exit 0 on both):

```
                                        main 791da070    head 350740dc
claude-haiku-5-5, 112K-token prompt     no row (unpriced) 18250
claude-opus-5-5                         15000            11000
Stop event costMicros / pricedRequests  15000 / 1        29250 / 2
```
